head.t: Trafford General performs UK's 100th Inspire sleep apnoea implant
head.x: ENT surgeons at Trafford General Hospital (Manchester University NHS FT) carried out the 100th UK procedure for the Inspire hypoglossal nerve stimulation implant for moderate-to-severe OSA in CPAP-intolerant patients.
